analysis: All 16 new paired training seeds, mean net-utility difference, exact paired sign-flip statistic and descriptive seed bootstrap as in archived runner. No dropping seed 202 analogues, no early stopping, no seed deletion after failures.
claimed_independence: Prospective new simulator training/confirmation seeds; no empirical independence or real-task qualification claimed before execution.
confirmation_boundary: Freeze all checkpoints and source/config manifests before generation. New task owner must verify all source bytes and expected development selector immediately before crossing that boundary. Existing runner has checkpoint freezing; no confirmation run is launched by this design artifact.
cost_reporting: Retain all attempt identities and consumed counts, train, development, generation, search/planning, confirmation, failure, exact recovery and audit durations; keep reused-selector fit costs separate. Report available energy/pricing or unknown explicitly. Host compute is not monetized by existing simulator utility; measured timings alone cannot establish positive all-in net benefit.
family_rule: Original frozen development rule only; never select/reselect a family from any confirmation result. An unexpected development selector result requires a source/determinism discrepancy report before new confirmation generation, not a new family selection.
later_crossed_seed_diagnosis: If further diagnosis is undertaken, split data seed, initialization seed and batch-order seed in train/dev only with explicit crossed design. Any model/hyperparameter change requires a separately identified new confirmation design before looking at confirmation data; this design cannot be silently amended.
primary_endpoint: selected family minus single-step mean net utility including observed history, paired by independent training seed
recovery: Only exact same source/config/seed/selected-checkpoint identity can reconcile an interrupted attempt. Retain original failures and charge recovery. Do not call a deterministic replay a new independent sample. No failed seed substitution.
scope_limit: Controlled simulator with fixed preparation options. Does not qualify owner runtime, real tools, autoregressive rollout, an integrated candidate, or complete physical costs.
secondary_endpoints: Forecast/calibration metrics, reset and no-action ablations are descriptive, not additional primary winners.
seed_derivation: For i=1..16: first 4 SHA256 bytes, big-endian integer, of UTF-8 hepta/PRED-1/independent-confirmation-002/2026-11-08/{i}. Fixed without looking at generated data.
selector_scope: These three original train/dev selectors are known development data, are not independent new evidence, and retain the original family-selection rule. Their 18 repeated fits count as costs. No original confirmation data may be opened.

success_criterion.assumption: Independent seed units and paired sign-exchangeability under the null. Episode-level counts do not replace independent training seeds.
